items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I think Dick Water was his name.

ctx.x: No. I can't think of the name of the guy. (inaudible) he wanted to book us to Japan. Yeah, Montreal. In Canada, You remember, Sue, Anyway, -- I think he lives in Toronto. Anyway, he called and said he wanted to get in touch with Dizzy Gillespie and Bud Powell, he wanted to use certain people. And I

think Dick Water was his name. My wife Celia really got it together. I didn't call nobody. I had a company and Max Roach decided to join it, and put the money up to record Charlie Parker, and Dizzy, at Jazz at Massey Hall. That was all.
Is it true that Dizzy -- I heard you had some problems getting there. I heard that Bird got lost or lost his horn or something like that.
